info.title: Allo API
info.description:
Allo API provides programmatic access to your Allo account, allowing you to manage webhooks, retrieve calls and contacts, and send SMS messages.

All requests to `/v1/api/**` endpoints automatically go through quota checking and scope validation.

tags.name: Summary Templates
tags.description: Manage call summary templates that control how AI-generated call summaries are structured for your team.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Manage webhook endpoints to receive real-time notifications about events in your Allo account. Each endpoint subscribes to one or more event topics and is verified with a signing secret.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Retrieve and search call records with filtering and pagination. Filter calls by your Allo phone number.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Search and retrieve contact information with sorting and pagination. Includes engagement level tracking.

tags.name: SMS
tags.description: Send SMS messages to phone numbers using your Allo numbers.

tags.name: Phone Numbers

tags.name: Analytics

tags.name: CRM

get.description: Returns the numbers in the Power Dialer queue currently assigned to the authenticated user, paginated and ordered by `position` ascending. `data` is the list of numbers (use `page`/`size` and read `pagination` to page through them); the `queue` key carries the queue's metadata (id, name, settings) without its numbers. To target a teammate's queue, pass either `user_id` or `email` as a query parameter (`user_id` wins when both are sent); the target must belong to the same team as the API key owner. When the user has no queue, the response is `200` with an empty `data` array, a zeroed `pagination`, and no `queue` (not a `404`).

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: ID of a teammate to read the queue for. Resolve teammate ids via [GET /v2/api/users](/en/v2/api-reference/users/list-users). Wins over `email` when both are provided.

parameters.name: email

parameters.name: page

delete.description: Removes numbers from the queue assigned to the authenticated user. Exactly one filter must be supplied via query string: `number` (E.164), `position` (0-based index), `number` + `position` together (delete a specific occurrence of a duplicate), or `unassigned=true` (remove every entry that has not been called yet). Combining `unassigned` with `number` or `position` is rejected. Pass `user_id` or `email` to clear a teammate's queue instead — `user_id` wins when both are provided.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Phone number to remove (any format — normalized to E.164). Removes every entry matching this number unless `position` is also supplied.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: 0-based position to remove. Combine with `number` to disambiguate when the same number appears more than once.

parameters.name: unassigned
parameters.description: When `true`, removes every queue entry that has not been called yet. Cannot be combined with `number` or `position`.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: ID of a teammate whose queue to clear. Resolve teammate ids via [GET /v2/api/users](/en/v2/api-reference/users/list-users). Wins over `email` when both are provided.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of a teammate whose queue to clear. Ignored when `user_id` is also supplied.

error.message: Provide at least one of 'number', 'position', or 'unassigned=true' to clear queue numbers.
error.suggestion: Add 'number', 'position', or 'unassigned=true' as a query parameter.
Use 'unassigned=true' alone, or remove it and rely on 'number'/'position'.

DialingQueue.description: A user's Power Dialer queue with its configuration and numbers.

creator_id.description: User ID of the queue creator — the user (or API key owner) that created the queue.

assignee_id.description: User ID of the user expected to run the queue. `GET /current` returns the queue where this matches the authenticated user (or the user resolved from `user_id` / `email`). Defaults to the creator when none was specified at creation time.

voicemail_handling.description: How the Power Dialer reacts when the call lands in voicemail. `SKIP` advances to the next number; `NO_SKIP` keeps the user on the call.

do_not_disturb.description: When `ENABLED`, incoming calls are silenced while the queue is being run.

DialingQueueMeta.description: Power Dialer queue metadata, without its numbers. Returned under the `queue` key of `GET /current`; the numbers themselves are the paginated `data`.

creator_id.description: User ID of the queue creator.

assignee_id.description: User ID of the user expected to run the queue.

voicemail_handling.description: How the Power Dialer reacts when the call lands in voicemail.

do_not_disturb.description: When `ENABLED`, incoming calls are silenced while the queue is being run.

QueueNumber.description: A phone number entry in a Power Dialer queue

call_start_date.description: When the user started calling this entry. `null` if the entry is still unassigned.

call_id.description: ID of the call placed for this entry (`cll-*`). `null` until a call is placed.

routing_result.description: Final routing outcome of the call placed for this entry.

sync_status.description: State of contact creation/sync for this entry.

detected_outbound_voicemail.description: Whether the call was detected as having reached a voicemail box.

not_reached_destination_reason.description: Why the call did not reach the contact (only set when applicable).

voicemail_left.description: Whether the user left a voicemail on this entry.

numbers.description: Numbers to append to the queue. Each entry requires a phone number; contact metadata is optional.

number.description: Phone number in any format — will be normalized to E.164

name.description: First name (optional — used to create or match a contact)

company.description: Company name — matched by name within the team (case-insensitive). If no matching company exists, one is created automatically.

user_id.description: Optional. ID of a teammate whose queue should receive the numbers. The teammate must belong to the same team as the API key owner. Wins over `email` when both are provided. Resolve teammate ids via [GET /v2/api/users](/en/v2/api-reference/users/list-users).

email.description: Optional. Email of a teammate whose queue should receive the numbers. Ignored when `user_id` is also supplied.

skipped.description: Numbers that were skipped (e.g. invalid format)

number.description: The raw input number that was skipped

UpsertDialingQueueRequest.description: Creates or updates the queue config. All fields are optional — only the fields you supply are touched. Pass `user_id` or `email` to act on a teammate's queue instead.

voicemail_handling.description: How the Power Dialer reacts when the call hits voicemail.

do_not_disturb.description: Silence inbound calls while running the queue.

user_id.description: Optional. ID of a teammate whose queue config should be updated. The teammate must belong to the same team as the API key owner. Wins over `email` when both are provided.

email.description: Optional. Email of a teammate whose queue config should be updated. Ignored when `user_id` is also supplied.

ResetDialingQueueRequest.description: Optional payload for resetting a queue. Send an empty body to reset your own queue without renaming.

name.description: Display name for the new queue (max 255 characters). Leave unset to create the queue without a name.

user_id.description: Optional. ID of a teammate the new queue should be assigned to. The API key owner is recorded as `creator_id`. The teammate must belong to the same team as the API key owner. Wins over `email` when both are provided.

email.description: Optional. Email of a teammate the new queue should be assigned to. Ignored when `user_id` is also supplied.

ClearQueueNumbersResponse.description: Result of clearing numbers from a Power Dialer queue.

removed.description: Number of queue entries that were removed.

compare_date.description: Comparison period. Metrics will include change vs this period.

user_ids.description: Filter by user IDs. Cannot be combined with allo_numbers.

allo_numbers.description: Filter by Allo numbers (E.164). Cannot be combined with user_ids.

tags.description: Tag keys that define a conversion (e.g. ['meeting_booked', 'demo_scheduled'])

extend.description: Include the list of outbound calls behind the funnel numbers. Requires `stage`.

stage.description: Filter drilldown items by funnel stage. Only used when `extend=items`.

page.description: Page number for drilldown items. Only used when `extend=items`.
